pricing.footnote: * Plus Stripe’s card processing on online card orders (currently {cardFee} in {country}), paid to Stripe, not HatchGrab. Walk-up orders use your own card reader — HatchGrab charges 0%.

order.walkUpOnly: This truck takes walk-up orders, in person.

toast.cardPayments: {state, select, off {{pah, select, on {Card payments off — customers pay at the truck} other {Card payments off — online ordering is paused until you turn them back on}}} other {Card payments back on}}

banner.cardPaymentsOff: Card payments are off — customers are paying at the truck. This stays off, on every event, until you turn it back on.

settings.cardsHelp: {pah, select, on {Turn this off during a card problem and customers will place orders as normal and pay at the truck instead. Orders keep coming; only the card step stops.} other {Turn this off during a card problem and online ordering stops until you turn it back on — your plan doesn’t include paying at the truck. Walk-up orders carry on as normal.}}

privateLink.orderingOffBody: This event isn’t taking orders online. Please order at the truck.

payNote.unknownBody: Your card was authorised, so please do not pay again — {truck} will confirm when you collect.
payNote.unknownText: We’re still confirming your payment. Your card was authorised, so please do not pay again — {truck} will confirm when you collect.

confirmation.textCollection: Collection time: {time}. See you at the truck!

header.fullTitle: Full cards — prices and payment details, as the counter sees them.

addOrder.catClosed: {cat} is closed for online orders this event — hidden from customers. You can still add walk-up orders at the truck; you’ll be asked to confirm.

qr.printHelp: Print or display this code so customers can scan and pre-order. Place it at your counter, on your truck, or share it online.

walkUp.body: How you take money at the truck. HatchGrab charges no platform fee on walk-ups, whichever you choose.

completionSettings.pressesTwoHelp: Best when payment and handover happen at different moments — someone pays at the truck, then collects when it’s ready. You get two buttons: “Mark paid” first, then “Collected” when they take the food.

detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the truck, paid on your own card terminal.
